name: Jay Mark V. Agsoy
major: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
bio: A computer science student who builds fast, dependable software and likes knowing how things work underneath, from interface physics to low-level binary tools.
philosophy: I believe working code beats perfect architecture.
Every decision should be reversible. Complexity is a liability until proven necessary.
Ship the smallest thing that solves the problem, then iterate.
I'd rather spend an hour preventing a bug than a day fixing one in production.
